questions.prompt: In *"The **tall** girl won the race"*, the bold word is a…
questions.explanation: "Tall" describes the noun "girl", so it is an adjective.

questions.prompt: In *"She sang **beautifully**"*, the bold word is a…
questions.explanation: "Beautifully" tells us *how* she sang — it describes the verb.

questions.prompt: Fill in with the correct word: *"He plays football very ____ (good/well)."*
questions.explanation: We need an adverb to describe "plays": *well*.

questions.prompt: In *"Can I have a **drink**?"*, "drink" is a…
questions.explanation: Here "drink" is a thing, so it is a noun.

questions.prompt: Write one sentence that contains at least one noun, one verb, one adjective and one adverb. Label each.
questions.marking_guide: 1 mark each for a correctly used and labelled noun, verb, adjective and adverb. Sentence must be grammatical.
